:::{#exm-negative-agreement}
#### Negative agreement for the COVID-19 test

For the agreement table of @exm-agreement-table-covid,
the negative agreement (@def-negative-agreement) is:

$$
\ba
p_{\text{neg}}
&= \frac{2 \times 9{,}207}{2 \times 9{,}207 + 93 + 7}
&& \text{(definition of } p_{\text{neg}} \text{, with the table's counts)} \\
&= \frac{18{,}414}{18{,}414 + 93 + 7}
&& \text{(multiply)} \\
&= \frac{18{,}414}{18{,}514}
&& \text{(add)} \\
&\approx 0.995
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$

The negative agreement is even higher than the overall agreement (@exm-overall-agreement),
because the 100 disagreements are small
relative to the 9,207 shared negative calls.

:::
